ModMetaData.name: RimMT Diagnostics v0.20.5 - Passive Fail-Safe
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Passive diagnostics companion for RimMT, including the T34-D aggressive parallel scanner counters. V0.20.5 installs no runtime tick, pawn, path, WorkGiver or MapComponent timing probes. On-demand reports read RimMT production counters and Harmony ownership. Report completion uses silent log lines instead of in-game Messages so it cannot request a UI notification sound.
